_comment: Sovrant bootstrap configuration. Copy this file to one of the locations below, then uncomment and edit the fields you want to override. Leave a field unset (or null) to keep the built-in default.
_locations: User-scoped:    ~/.sovrant/sovrant.config.json (your personal default for all workspaces)
Custom path:    pass --config <path> on the command line
_precedence: CLI flags > environment variables > project file > user file > built-in defaults
